---
title: "2. Statistical Learning"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 10 weeks  
**Outcome:** Understand and implement the main classical ML methods and their statistical logic.
:::

## Core topics

Bias–variance; empirical risk; regularisation; ridge/LASSO/elastic net; trees; bagging; random forests; boosting; cross-validation; model selection; high-dimensional statistics.

## Essential resources

- James, G., Witten, D., Hastie, T., Tibshirani, R., & Taylor, J. (2023). *An Introduction to Statistical Learning: With Applications in Python*. Springer. <https://www.statlearning.com/>
- Stanford **CS229: Machine Learning** — <https://cs229.stanford.edu/>
- Wainwright, M. J. (2019). *High-Dimensional Statistics*. Cambridge University Press.

## Milestone

Compare OLS, LASSO, random forests and gradient boosting on an economic prediction problem using a strict out-of-sample design.
